validationBoundaries: Pure helper tests use author-specified literal coordinate expectations; they do not replace the independent PDF rotation/UserUnit/EXIF oracle or actual DOM hit-testing.

Frame registration is a renderer ownership contract, not a cryptographic proof of DOM visibility or re-decoding. Actual renderer/page/geometry integration is independently verified by UI/browser owners.

Cold stored coordinates never recreate a live source, automatically highlight a current file, read a file, dispatch Agent work or send an opinion. Cold semantic checks are TypeScript, not a Rust area enum.
Rust tests operate solely on temporary SQLite files and protected copies. They prove selected-record retention/CAS/rollback-related regression, not the installed native recovery journey.
